conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Department. This is Agent Harper speaking. Can I have your full name for verification, please?
Hello, yes, my name is Arjun Patel. Someone left a message saying I need to call urgently about my taxes.
Thank you, Mr. Patel. For security, can you confirm the last four digits of your Social Security Number?
Thank you. I'm reviewing your IRS records now. It appears there are significant discrepancies in your federal income tax filings from the past three years.
I... I'm not sure what that means. I always try to be careful with my taxes.
I understand, sir. Unfortunately, our audit system has flagged several underreported amounts. The outstanding total, including penalties and interest, is $7,800.
That can't be right. I use an accountant. Can you check again?
I wish I could adjust this, but the IRS system is automated. If this is not resolved today, enforcement measures will be initiated by our legal department.
Enforcement? What does that mean for me? I am here on a work visa. I cannot have problems with the law.

If you do not settle this matter, Mr. Patel, it could result in liens on your assets, freezing of your bank accounts, and a case file sent for criminal investigation. This may impact your residency status.
No, please, I cannot have my visa or job affected. How can I fix this?
Because you contacted us before legal action started, you are eligible for a one-time rapid settlement. But you must act immediately to avoid escalation.
Okay. What do I need to do?

To process the settlement, you can make the payment through government-approved methods: direct wire transfer, prepaid gift cards, or cryptocurrency. Which is most convenient for you to arrange right now?
I don't know... maybe prepaid cards? But this seems unusual for the IRS.
I assure you, sir, due to the urgent nature and to prevent further penalties, we use expedited payment methods. Do not discuss this call with anyone, as it will complicate your case.
Alright. Where do I get these cards?
You can purchase Target or Walmart gift cards at any convenience store or supermarket. You will need to get enough cards to cover the full amount, $7,800.
That is a lot of money. Can I pay part now?
Due to the severity, the minimum to halt legal action is $4,000 today. Once you have the cards, remain on the line and read me the numbers on the back for verification.
I will try, but what happens if I cannot get all the cards now?

If you cannot provide the amount, the full balance will be due immediately, and the IRS will proceed with wage garnishment and a freeze on your accounts. This is your only chance to resolve it voluntarily.
Okay, I will go to the store now. Should I call back?
No, Mr. Patel, for your protection, stay on the line until the transaction is completed. Do not speak to anyone about this, or your file will be marked as non-cooperative.
This is very stressful. I just want this to go away.
I understand. The fastest way is to do exactly as I instruct. Once you have the cards, read the numbers and I will process your settlement immediately. Are you ready to proceed?
Yes, I am going to the store now.
